title: DNF repositories, modules, and history
subtitle: Know exactly where packages come from, which stream is enabled, and how to reverse a transaction.
objectives: Inspect enabled repositories and package provenance
Write a repository definition with a working baseurl
Explain module streams and the RHEL 9 versus RHEL 10 difference
Use DNF history to review and undo a transaction
Verify package ownership and file integrity

ex200.evidence: dnf repolist and dnf info output.
dnf module list/enable and version-specific explanation.

versionNotes: RHEL 9 uses DNF 4. RHEL 10 ships DNF5: familiar verbs remain, but output, configuration commands, and some module workflows differ.
DNF5 on RHEL 10 handles modularity differently and does not expose every DNF 4 module subcommand. Pin versions through repositories or AppStream content and test the exact release.

commands.desc: Show enabled repositories and their base URLs.
List module streams on a RHEL 9 system.
Enable a module stream before installing.
List transactions with IDs and actions.
Find the package that owns a file.
Verify installed files against package metadata.

lab.title: Add a repository, choose a stream, install, inspect
lab.scenario: Create a local repository definition, refresh metadata, inspect a module stream, install nginx, and review the transaction history.

steps.text: Inspect enabled repositories and confirm package provenance.
steps.verify: Repository IDs are visible and nginx resolves to a repository.

steps.text: Create a repository file with a baseurl, enabled flag, and GPG checking.
steps.verify: The .repo file contains section name, baseurl, enabled=1, and gpgcheck=1.

steps.text: Refresh metadata so DNF reads the new repository.
steps.verify: Metadata cache is created without an error from the new repo.

steps.text: Inspect the PHP module stream and enable the 8.2 stream.
steps.cmd: dnf module list php && sudo dnf module enable php:8.2
steps.verify: The enabled stream is recorded and the next install would use it.

steps.text: Install nginx, then review history and package ownership.
steps.cmd: sudo dnf install -y nginx && sudo dnf history && rpm -qf /usr/sbin/nginx
steps.verify: nginx is installed, history shows the transaction, and rpm -qf identifies the owner.

quiz.q: Where do local DNF repository definitions normally live?
quiz.why: DNF reads .repo files from /etc/yum.repos.d; /etc/dnf/dnf.conf supplies global settings.

options: A named version track for a package set
quiz.why: A stream selects a version track for modular content, such as php:8.2 versus php:8.0.

quiz.q: Which command reverses an earlier DNF transaction?
quiz.why: dnf history undo uses the transaction ID and plans the reverse operations.
